note: Adapted from the species-level 'Diagnostic characters' of State Fauna Series 8, Fauna of Gujarat, original English. The source treats this species as Synhamitermes labioangulatus Thakur (described in 1989, type locality Kaprada Forest, Gujarat, India). OCR issues: 'Labi um' is a broken form of labrum; 'Govatka' is inconsistent with the recorded Govalka and both spellings occur in the original.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark yellow to light brown, body yellow-white. Body length 4.15—4.25 mm. Head nearly square, slightly longer than wide (length 1.0—1.06 mm, width 0.88—0.91 mm), widest at the antennal bases. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 1 longest, segment 2 about two thirds as long as segment 1, segment 3 shortest. Labrum pentagonal, very wide at the base, with a few long hairs. Mandibles stout, apices strongly incurved, each mandible with a large, sharp, slightly upturned tooth at the middle. Postmentum swollen, bare. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.32—0.34 mm, width 0.50—0.64 mm, with a shallow median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, with a distinct median notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and pronotum yellow-white, inner margin of the mandibles dark brown. Body length 3.25—3.37 mm. Head nearly square, wider than long; head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 0.75—0.81 mm, width 0.81—0.86 mm. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 1 largest and cylindrical, segment 3 shortest, terminal segment oval. Labrum short, length 0.22—0.25 mm, width 0.20—0.22 mm, with a few small hairs on the outer margin. Mandibles nearly square; left mandible with an apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, right mandible with an apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth. Pronotum saddle-shaped; width 0.50—0.55 mm, length 0.25—0.28 mm.
